caveats: epoch propagation uses proper motion only (no parallax/RV terms)
AllWISE mean epoch approximated as 2010.5 for all sources
sigma_stat uses the Ren et al. 2026 eq. 1 form FWHM / (2.355 SNR); any departure of the real windowed-centroid noise from it is absorbed into sigma_sys
controls are W3-detected M dwarfs: sigma_sys applies to the drill-down W3 SNR regime
description: Empirical AllWISE W3 centroid registration floor sigma_sys measured on isolated, RUWE-clean Gaia DR3 M-dwarf control stars across separated high-latitude patches; sigma_sys fitted on the calibration half, 3-sigma centroid false-alarm rate evaluated out-of-sample on the withheld half.

cuts_in_order: exclude published Hephaistos candidates (adversary claim file)
no other Gaia DR3 source within 15.0 arcsec
W3 cutout finite within 3 FWHM; centroid converged inside cutout
selection.gaia: parallax > 3.3333 mas (d < 300 pc), parallax_over_error > 10, BP-RP >= 1.84, 10 <= G <= 16, AllWISE best neighbour (gaiadr3.allwise_best_neighbour)
selection.isolation_adql_template: SELECT source_id, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', {ra:.7f}, {dec:.7f}, {r:.7f}))
selection.split: stratified by patch, alternating labels, SeedSequence([42, 2])

estimator_definitions.rayleigh_mle: heteroscedastic Rayleigh MLE, s_i^2 = sigma_stat_i^2 + x^2 (fermi_desk.models.hephaistos.sigma_sys_mle); not outlier-robust
estimator_definitions.robust_median: x >= 0 solving median_i[r_i / sqrt(sigma_stat_i^2 + x^2)] = sqrt(2 ln 2) (fermi_desk.models.hephaistos.sigma_sys_robust)

statistics.primary_estimator_rationale: Fixed BEFORE the seed-42 production run, after a seed-7 two-patch smoke test showed a 'clean' control with a 6.39 arcsec W3 offset (an unseen background source). The Rayleigh MLE / moment estimators are not outlier-robust: such stars would inflate sigma_sys and blind the centroid screen to the blends it exists to catch. The median-matched estimator (50% breakdown) is primary; MLE and moment values are reported alongside. Withheld false-alarm counts include every control, so contamination is reported, not removed.
